title: Xiaomi 18 Pro boasts rear screen for easy selfies

blocks.text: Xiaomi has teased the Xiaomi 18 Pro that may soon make waves in Philippine shores. The new device adds second screen on the back by the camera module allowing for several new possibilities with the phone’s UI.

The biggest boon is you can now use the main camera as a selfie cam. The rumored 2.7″ AMOED display easily acts as the selfie screen as well as a convenient notifications pop up screen for when on the go. It will also be rumored to have a triple camera Leica system with a 200MP main camera, 200MP periscope telephoto, and 50MP wide camera.

The Xiaomi 18 Pro unveiling comes as the company unveils the new HyperOS 4 operating system. The new OS introduces a glass-like UI across eligible devices, widget stacking, expanded AI tools, and performance upgrades for app launches.
